lead_raw_text:
The structure of Li2Mn2Fe8O16 (reduced formula LiMn(FeO2)4) is monoclinic, space group C2/c (No. 15), with 28 atoms per unit cell distributed over five independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-derived analysis gives Fe centers six O neighbors, Mn centers four O neighbors, and Li centers eight O neighbors. The oxygen environments are three- or four-coordinate, with Fe–O distances of 1.884–1.992 Å. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows corner- and edge-sharing between Fe and Li polyhedra and between Li and Mn polyhedra, while O-centered polyhedra share corners and edges.
